title: Azeroth Expansion
description: Azeroth Expansion adds new ores inspired by WoW. Mine Raw Silver, Raw True Silver, Raw Mithril, Raw Dark Iron, Raw Tin, and Raw Thorium. Future updates will introduce refined ingots, powerful weapons, and armor forged from these legendary materials.
